uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Token Wardrobe on this device. "Like Foundry" follows Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature shows the windows on warm paper, Foundry keeps them dark like the rest of Foundry.

sheetButton.name: Button on the sheet portrait
sheetButton.hint: Show a small shirt button over the portrait of every character sheet. It opens the outfits next to the portrait. This device only.

hudButton.name: Button in the token HUD
hudButton.hint: Show the shirt button in the token HUD. This device only.

playersWear.name: Players put outfits on
playersWear.hint: Players who own a character can switch its outfits.

playersEdit.name: Players manage the wardrobe
playersEdit.hint: Players who own a character can add, rename, sort and remove its outfits.

allScenes.name: Linked tokens on all scenes
allScenes.hint: A new outfit also goes on the linked tokens of the character on every scene. Players ask the GM client to do the scenes they cannot change. Off: only the scene you are looking at.

transition.name: Change of the token image
transition.hint: How the token image changes when an outfit goes on.

automation.name: Automatic outfits
automation.hint: Outfits with an automation put themselves on at the start of a fight, below a share of hit points or while a status is active. Only the active GM runs the rules.

SELFTEST.Title: Self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks after an update that everything the module relies on is there.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Foundry is newer than the verified version ({versions}). Run the self test if something looks wrong.
SELFTEST.Hud: The token HUD palette is missing.
SELFTEST.Sheet: The actor sheet class is missing.
SELFTEST.Wildcard: The list of wildcard images is missing.
SELFTEST.Bar: The token bar reading is missing.
SELFTEST.Transitions: Foundry does not know the token changes: {types}
SELFTEST.Status: The list of status effects is missing.
SELFTEST.Socket: The socket of the module is not switched on.
SELFTEST.ActiveGM: Foundry does not name the active GM.
SELFTEST.Logic: The rules for file names, scale and automation do not work.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: One file about all of Sephral's modules in this world, for bug reports. It contains chat text and whispers.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file saved: {file}. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.

Window.title: Wardrobe: {name}
Window.menuHint: Opens the wardrobe of the selected token or of your character.
Window.addImageHint: Pick one image or video in the file browser and make an outfit of it
Window.uploadHint: Upload images from your computer. You can also drop them anywhere in this window.
Window.folderHint: Make an outfit of every image in a folder
Window.suggestHint: Look next to the portrait and the token image for files with a similar name
Window.wildcardHint: Take the images of the random token as outfits
Window.newHint: Add an empty outfit and fill it with images
Window.emptyText: An outfit is a portrait and a token image with a name. One click puts it on, and the sheet and the token change together.
Window.dropHint: Drop images here: from your computer, from the file browser or from another character. Files named like hero-token and hero-portrait become one outfit.
Window.noFiles: You may not browse or upload files. You can still put outfits on. The GM can allow file access in the permission settings.
Window.noUpload: You may not upload files, so images cannot be dropped in from your computer. Images from the file browser still work.
Window.noBrowse: You may not browse files. Drop images in or upload them.
Window.noUploadNotice: You may not upload files. Ask the GM for the permission.
Window.noBrowseNotice: You may not browse files. Ask the GM for the permission, or drop an image into the window.
Window.nothingNew: Nothing new: these images are already in the wardrobe.
Window.skipped: Files skipped, only images and videos are accepted: {count}.
Window.folderFailed: The folder {path} could not be read.
Window.wildcardNone: This token has no wildcard images.

Card.portraitEmpty: No portrait: the portrait stays as it is
Card.tokenEmpty: No token image: the token stays as it is
Card.name: Name of the outfit
Card.scaleHint: Scale of the token image, empty keeps the token as it is
Card.removeText: Remove {name} from the wardrobe? The image files stay.

Auto.title: Automation: {name}
Auto.intro: This outfit puts itself on when one of these is true. The first matching outfit in the list wins. When the situation ends, the outfit chosen by hand comes back.
Auto.combat: While the character is in a running fight
Auto.hp: When the hit points are below
Auto.status: While one of these statuses is active
Auto.outro: Leave everything off for a normal outfit. Only the active GM applies the rules.

Suggest.title: Variants for {name}
Suggest.intro: These files look like variants of the portrait or the token image. Tick the ones to add.
Suggest.none: No similar files found next to the images.

Palette.emptyEdit: No outfits yet. Open the wardrobe to make some.

Keys.nextOutfit: Next outfit of the selected tokens
Keys.previousOutfit: Previous outfit of the selected tokens
Keys.openWardrobe: Open the wardrobe of the selected token

Notify.noRight: You may not change the outfit of {name}.
Notify.noOutfits: {name} has no outfits to switch between.
Notify.videoPortrait: A video can only be a token image, not a portrait.
